chapter: Writing, Oklahoma roots and the origins of bebop
title: First night in Minneapolis and the Breakfast Club
summary: Arriving broke, he sits in with the Pettifords.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: play. When I was up in Minneapolis, I was up there with the band, and I... When I first came into Minneapolis I didn't know a soul in Minneapolis. I was a game little stud. I thought, "I must be crazy." Every day I'd say, "What am I doing here? No one, no nothin', no job, no nothin'. And I had two dollars in my pocket, man. I said, "Gee, I ain't too bright."

But I was lucky I got a gig. Paul Cephus(?), a piano player up there, sounded me when I first came in town. The first night I hit town, they had a jam session at the Breakfast Club, where all the musicians would come down and play. So I went down and sat in with Alonzo and Ira and Oscar, and we all... Because we was all about the same age. So it was just like a real get-together thing.
But you hadn't heard them before you hit Minneapolis.
Yeah. That was... They were living in Minneapolis, see, and I had come down from North Dakota.
